description: Read the selected fields of feed articles using a fixed record XPath and relative field selectors.

interface.semantic_input: A readable local XML document and the exact article and field selector tuple.
interface.semantic_output: One-based article rows in document order, with the selected attribute values and direct title text.

abstraction: local XML document to positioned row visitor
implementation_form: retained C++ adapter using the extracted pugixml XPath evaluator
resources: Loads an XML document and sorts the record node set before visitation. Peak memory, maximum input size and throughput are unmeasured.

preconditions.detail: Supply a readable local XML file and the reviewed selectors. Each selected record must be a node. Each field selector must match exactly one node or attribute for that record.

postconditions.detail: The exact tuple returned one-based article rows in document order. It preserved field order and decoded UTF-8, entity references, and CDATA on the tested documents.

refinements.detail: A nested record outside the exact path was excluded. A mixed-content title returned its first direct text segment in the tested document. Empty attributes and empty elements yielded empty strings.

effects.detail: Input fixture hashes were preserved. The surrounding emitted programs preserved the previous destination state on the tested parse and field errors.

invariants.detail: Duplicate articles retained separate positions. Repeated successful visits produced the same fields and positions. The XPath union control returned selected records in document order.

mathematical_properties.detail: General XPath equivalence and complexity bounds remain open.

formal_predicates.detail: The detached domain records both exact selector arguments together. It supplies no proof over arbitrary XML documents.

state_protocol.detail: The empty field selector failed during producer creation. Parse and invalid XPath errors failed during visitation. A late missing or repeated field stopped after one already delivered row.

ownership.detail: The producer captures the path and selector text by value. The document belongs to each visit and row fields are borrowed during the callback.

concurrency.detail: Concurrent visits and input changes during visitation were untested.

upstream_usage.detail: The adapter selects record nodes with pugixml, sorts them in document order and reads fields relative to each node. The signed XPath source, SDK headers and retained kernel are pinned.

specification_question.detail: Which XPath locates a record and which relative paths locate its fields? This scope covers the exact feed article tuple.
